doc_friction.issue: Step 0 says to fix every open entry first, but all 9 open entries are control-plane fixes (prompts/, .github/, control_plane_guard.py) that this run cannot land without owner approval; the list re-prints the same blocked items every run. It would help to mark entries as 'awaiting owner PR #N' so `redteam.py open` can separate actionable from blocked.

The redteam prompt says to look at files changed on main in the last 3 days, but the clone is depth-1, so `git log --since=3.days --name-only origin/main` returns nothing without a deepen; the random draw was used instead.

deviations.why: Step 0 asks to fix the open list before seeding; every entry needs a control-plane PR with owner approval.
deviations.did: Checked each one still reproduces on main (none fixed; grep for each fix's marker), left them as they were, and went on to seed.
deviations.result: No step-0 entry patched; the run's time went to 3 new real defects instead.

notes: Guard added (4b): platform/ci/check_finite_thresholds.py, run on PRs via unwired_checks.py; its first run found 4 bare type=float threshold flags (3 in platform/ci, 1 in coverage-drop-check), all fixed. Sibling defects found by searching the same class: agentic-trading-lab NaN risk limits and NaN order notionals; backup-verification-evidence NaN max_age_hours classified as verified. Verification: run_venture_tests.py agentic-trading-lab coverage-drop-check backup-verification-evidence -> 3 ok (44, 50, 145 tests); platform/ci unittest test_check_finite_thresholds, test_adopt_stranded, test_check_site_fresh, test_post_similarity, test_unwired_checks -> OK; check_post_frontmatter ok.

mutants.note: Prolog-only paste (<?xml ...?>) parsed as a tag and no longer threw 'no XML tags found'. New test: 'a paste that is only an XML declaration...'.
JaCoCo per-line ci fallback (sourcefile with no LINE counter) was never exercised; every fixture had counters. New test: 'JaCoCo sourcefiles without a LINE counter...'.

real_defects.issue: compare_coverage accepted --max-drop inf (only nan and negatives were rejected), so `check.py base.xml cur.xml --max-drop inf` reported a 50-point drop as 'within the inf point allowance' and exited 0: a CI gate that silently always passes. The browser page (compare.mjs) already rejects it with Number.isFinite. Fixed with math.isfinite and test_max_drop_rejects_infinity_and_nan.

Risk guards failed open on NaN: check_orders accepted an Order with notional=nan (neither > max nor < min), check_targets returned no error for a NaN weight, and Limits(max_order_notional=nan) or `rebalance --max-order nan` / `--max-weight nan` disabled the per-order and per-symbol limits (a 1e9 order accepted). Fixed: Limits.__post_init__ rejects non-finite/negative limits, non-finite notional and weights are rejected with a reason, and the CLI flags use a finite-only argparse type. Tests: test_guards_fail_closed_on_nan_and_inf, test_rebalance_refuses_a_nan_limit_from_the_command_line.

classify_run read expected.max_age_hours / min_size_bytes unchecked: NaN or Infinity (which json.loads accepts, and which `record --max-age-hours nan` wrote, since record used type=float while verify already used _positive_hours) made a 4-day-old artifact classify as verified; a string threshold crashed with TypeError. Fixed: _threshold() turns a non-finite/non-number threshold into a reason (status suspicious), record uses _positive_hours. Tests: test_a_nan_or_non_number_threshold_fails_closed, test_record_refuses_a_nan_or_infinite_max_age.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: mutation triage of one file, three cross-venture NaN fixes with tests, an AST lint and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
